AboutNdcSection.title: Nagarjuna Degree College
AboutNdcSection.subTitle: A Gateway to Excellence
description: Being one of the Top Degree Colleges in Bengaluru, Nagarjuna Degree College is a prominent pillar of the Nagarjuna Group of Institutions. This eminent institution was established in the year 2013 with the vision of Leadership and Excellence in Education. Therefore, with state-of-the-art campus and advanced facilities, it follows the path of experiential learning offering UG and PG programmes in the field of Commerce, Science and Management.

Yrs25Section.title: Celebrating 25 Years of Academic Excellence
Yrs25Section.description: For the past 25 years, Nagarjuna Degree College has been a hub of innovation, learning, and career-focused education. Our dedication to academic excellence has shaped countless bright minds, equipping them with the skills to excel in an ever-evolving world. As we mark this milestone, we reaffirm our commitment to fostering knowledge, embracing new advancements, and empowering the next generation of leaders. Here's to a future built on excellence and innovation!

EducationExcellence.title: Education & Excellence For Everyone
EducationExcellence.subTitle: Courses Offered
EducationExcellence.description: Nagarjuna Degree College nurtures future-ready graduates through value-driven education, modern infrastructure, and industry-aligned programs. As part of the Nagarjuna Group of Institutions, it blends academics, mentorship, and innovation to shape leaders, entrepreneurs, and socially responsible individuals prepared to excel in a dynamic world.
